doctrine: UPSTREAM DEFINES INTENT. DOWNSTREAM INCREASES FIDELITY.

authored_authority.rule: COMPOSITION INTENT + BRAND WORLD + OFFICIAL LOGO/TYPE + BESPOKE ART DIRECTION + DETERMINISTIC PRODUCT UI = FINISHED AUTHORITY. SCENE PLATE + OVERLAY IS NOT.
authored_authority.founder_verdict: A founder REJECTED verdict blocks authority even when every mechanical check passes.

evaluator: checkCompositeAuthority({ blueprint, ownership, profile, composite, renderer_model })
art_layers: One accepted plate per generator / COMPOSITE layer, from the profile renderer (never a local approximation), passing generator QA, the baked-UI guard and contamination.
anti_ai: The creative-direction anti-AI flags apply to the composite; a MATERIAL flag blocks.

richness.rule: A sparse layout with correct colours is not rich.

product_clarity.rule: The primary signal is understood without interpreting the metaphor.
